reason: A is the stronger proposal because it specifies a more conservative substitution range, quantitative density and property targets, loading/temperature boundaries, a composition series, and explicit rejection thresholds. Although its predicted density reduction may be optimistic and Al-induced B2/intermetallic formation at 1000 °C remains a serious risk, B is less quantitative, internally inconsistent about the as-cast condition versus homogenization, and more closely reprises the previously studied Al0.4Hf0.6 substitution strategy despite evidence of degraded plasticity.
